zones.description: waiting zone: the right-hand approach lanes just before the stop line of the pedestrian crossing (top-down view)

lines.description: stop line at the near edge of the pedestrian crossing; cars travel from bottom-right to top-left

rule_text: Every car must wait at least 1.5 seconds in the waiting zone before it crosses the stop line.
labeled_by: EventProof developer (hand labels from 2-5 fps frame sheets, before any model run)

objects.description: red car entering at the right edge ~2.0 s, rolls through and crosses ~4.2 s without stopping
silver sedan entering ~5.5 s, stands still ~7.5-11.5 s, crosses ~13.7 s
white van entering ~13.8 s, rolls through at ~50 px/s (never stops, checked at 5 fps) and crosses ~17.0 s
white car waiting in the left-hand lane the whole clip (upper of the two, lower-left of the frame)
white car waiting in the left-hand lane the whole clip (lower, at the bottom-left edge)
